implementationReadiness.coordinateRule: In 3C-1e, freeze exact current points from official street addresses plus current map evidence. Never use barangay centroids. Preserve historical addresses as aliases/provenance rather than duplicate assets.

findings: The current 11-station fire network is fully named on the City Government of Makati hotline page and matches the 2023 official count.
Ayala Satellite and Bel-Air FSS are current Makati fire stations not present in the older 2020 eleven-station main list; West Rembo and Comembo are now outside Makati.
The current police completeness denominator is one headquarters plus Sub-Stations 1–7.
NAPOLCOM formally transferred the old Makati Sub-Stations 8 and 9 to Taguig.
The Makati Police headquarters current operational address has shifted from the older Ayala/Yakal listing to Malugay/Mayapis in newer 2025–2026 station evidence.
Sub-Stations 1–7 retain stable neighborhood identities, though several street/address details have evolved; the verification record keeps both current and historical address evidence where needed.
